provenance: Original synthetic stimuli designed for this proposed study; not model outputs; no participant data.

formal.name: Extend an arrow tip
formal.instruction: Move the tip 20 px right. Keep the shoulders and shaft fixed.

formal.name: Tilt a droplet tip
formal.instruction: Move the tip 18 px left and 14 px up. Preserve the lower body.

formal.name: Expand one side of a leaf
formal.instruction: Raise the upper arc by about 16 px. Keep both tips and lower arc fixed.

formal.name: Raise a rounded cap
formal.instruction: Raise the top midpoint 18 px. Preserve the sides, base and symmetry.

formal.name: Widen a rounded slot
formal.instruction: Move each slot wall 12 px outward. Keep slot depth and outer edges fixed.

formal.name: Deepen a curved notch
formal.instruction: Deepen the notch by about 20 px. Keep its opening and outer boundary fixed.

practice.name: Practice: move a corner
practice.instruction: Move the top corner upward; use Undo once.

practice.name: Practice: change curvature
practice.instruction: Raise the upper curve while keeping the lower curve fixed.
